notes.title: A Celebratory "Feel Bad Friday"
notes.content:
To celebrate the Steam Release of The Electric Shocktopus, I decided to do a [url=https://youtu.be/mxLKtCIkjEA]very special Let's Play video of it.[/url]

Backstory: there is a level editor in the game, and players have made some *impressive* levels. Some are wicked hard, and I've taken it upon myself to film YouTube videos of me attempting to beat these levels.  I figure, hey, I made the game, I should be able to beat any level in it, right?

Anyway, I've made over 30 of these videos over the year(s?) and today I decided to go back and replay ALL the levels.  See how far I can make it in each, with only one life to live.

Answer: not too far.

[url=https://youtu.be/mxLKtCIkjEA]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27026468/e656809fa20a7c49b1963a08016853b2275e99ab.png[/img]
Click here to watch the video[/url]

A big thanks to everyone who supported me and helped me get to this point and release this game on Steam.  And thanks to you for watching/playing/your interest!
